hero.title: Radiant Waves Media Morning Global News
hero.description: Saturday, August 22, 2026. Good morning. Here are the latest verified global headlines, breaking developments, business, technology, Europe and Africa news from around the world.

breaking: 🔴 Sweden: One person killed and three injured in sword attack at a high school in Fagersta
🔴 Ukraine: European leaders prepare a Coalition of the Willing meeting to strengthen support for Kyiv
🔴 Spain: Ceuta migrant crisis remains under scrutiny after a deadly border rush
🔴 United States: Federal debt has surpassed $40 trillion for the first time
🔴 Iceland: Voters prepare for an August 29 referendum on whether to reopen EU membership negotiations
🔴 Nigeria: Families protest nearly 100 days after children were abducted in Borno State
🔴 Nigeria: Election campaigning is underway ahead of January's presidential election
🔴 Global markets: Investors watch oil, bond yields, the dollar, Nvidia earnings and the Federal Reserve

featured.title: Sweden High School Attack Leaves One Dead
featured.content: An 18-year-old former student armed with a sword attacked Brinell High School in Fagersta, Sweden, on Friday. One person was killed and three others were injured. Police shot and detained the suspect, who is being investigated on suspicion of murder. The school had recently reopened after the summer break.

articles.title: Deadly School Attack Shocks Sweden
articles.description: An 18-year-old man armed with a sword attacked students at Brinell High School in Fagersta. One person died and three were injured before police shot and detained the suspect. Authorities are continuing their investigation.

articles.title: European Leaders Prepare Fresh Support For Ukraine
articles.description: French President Emmanuel Macron, British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz are due to co-chair a Coalition of the Willing meeting on Monday. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky is expected to participate remotely from Kyiv.

articles.title: Ceuta Migrant Crisis Remains In Focus
articles.description: Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta remains under scrutiny after a deadly border rush. The first migrants who died during the recent incident have been buried while authorities continue identifying victims and managing the aftermath.

articles.title: US Federal Debt Surpasses $40 Trillion
articles.description: The United States federal debt has crossed the $40 trillion mark for the first time, according to the U.S. Treasury. The milestone is intensifying debate about government finances, interest costs and America's long-term fiscal outlook.

articles.title: Iceland Prepares For EU Referendum
articles.description: Iceland will vote on August 29 on whether to reopen negotiations on European Union membership. The referendum is not a vote on joining the EU itself. A successful vote would begin negotiations, with any eventual membership deal requiring another referendum.

articles.title: Nigerian Families Demand Release Of Abducted Children
articles.description: Families in Borno State are demanding government action nearly 100 days after children were abducted from Mussa. Around 45 children remain unaccounted for, while another group of students and a teacher abducted in June also remain in captivity.

articles.title: Nigeria's 2027 Election Campaign Gathers Momentum
articles.description: Nigeria has entered the election campaign season ahead of January's polls. President Bola Tinubu is seeking another term, with economic conditions, insecurity, employment and living standards expected to dominate the political debate.

articles.title: Nigeria's Economy Remains A Major Election Issue
articles.description: Economic reforms have improved some investor and government-finance indicators but have also placed significant pressure on households. The cost of living, purchasing power, inflation and employment are expected to remain central issues during the campaign.

articles.title: Global Markets Face Pressure From High Bond Yields
articles.description: Global stocks and bonds remain under pressure as investors assess high government borrowing costs, inflation risks and geopolitical uncertainty. Oil prices and the direction of interest rates remain important market drivers.

articles.title: Investors Look Ahead To Nvidia Earnings
articles.description: Nvidia's upcoming earnings report is expected to be closely watched as investors assess whether the artificial-intelligence investment boom can continue supporting technology valuations.

articles.title: AI Investment Remains A Global Market Driver
articles.description: Artificial intelligence continues to attract enormous investment in computing infrastructure, semiconductors and data centres. Investors are increasingly examining how much financing will be required to sustain the rapid expansion.

articles.title: Technology Sector Faces Rising Financing Pressure
articles.description: Higher bond yields and borrowing costs are creating new questions about the financing of major technology and AI infrastructure projects, even as demand for advanced computing continues to grow.

articles.title: Ukraine Remains A Major European Security Concern
articles.description: European governments continue discussing military assistance, security guarantees and diplomatic options as Russia's war against Ukraine continues. The Coalition of the Willing meeting is expected to focus on maintaining support for Kyiv.

articles.title: Global Security And Migration Remain In Focus
articles.description: Wars, migration pressures, public safety and economic uncertainty continue shaping international policy debates as governments attempt to balance security with humanitarian responsibilities.

articles.title: Today's Big Question
articles.description: With wars, insecurity, economic pressure and migration affecting millions of people, what should governments put first — protecting lives, creating jobs, or strengthening national security? Share your thoughts in the comments.

articles.title: Inspirational Quote Of The Day
articles.description: You may not be able to change the whole world today, but one wise decision, one kind action and one brave step can change someone's world.
